description: Search tools, roles, tasks and sectors in plain language, with spelling correction. Returns sourced tool listings and the taxonomy terms the query matched. Example: "meeting transcription" or "hotel manager". Each listing includes the tool's own MCP server, if any; set mcp to keep only tools that connect to AI assistants.

mcp.description: Only tools whose own MCP server matches: yes, no, or a connection type (oauth = sign in with account, none = no sign-in, api-key, local).

query.description: What the person wants to do, their role, their sector or a tool name.

name: search_tools
title: Search ToolGrail
